items.title: Leading the energy transition: stereotypes, AI and what stays human
items.summary: This week, Women in Solar+ Europe (WiSEu) and Solar+ Leaders reflect on two workshops held in Madrid during Genera that examined how bias shapes everyday leadership decisions in the energy transition. The WiSEu breakfast workshop explored who gets heard in meetings, who receives credit for their work and who gets the chance to progress. The Solar+ Leaders workshop asked what happens when AI agents join a team, and how leaders decide what to delegate and who is accountable for the outcome. Both discussions came back to a question that matters for the sector’s ability to deliver: how can leaders recognise the assumptions behind their decisions before those assumptions shape the way their teams work? The post Leading the energy transition: stereotypes, AI and what stays human appeared first on pv magazine Global .
